_comment: pack-v1 carries the queue's existing wording VERBATIM — the mechanism shipped first; pack-v2 is the wording pass in Viva's own manner (docs/viva-persona.md). A released pack is never edited; add a new pack directory instead.
identity: I read a statement for {account_ref}, but I can't tell whose account it is. Is it one you already have, or a new one?
reconciliation_gap: Your {account_ref} statement for {opening_date} – {closing_date} doesn't continue from the balance I hold. A statement between them looks missing — is one?
reconciliation_gap_why: It opens at {opening_money}; my chain ends elsewhere.
reconciliation_flagged: Your {account_ref} statement didn't add up, so I haven't posted it. Can you check the figure I flagged?
reconciliation_held: I'm holding a {doc_type} {for_account} that didn't reconcile, so its figures aren't on your books.
transfer: On {date} you moved {money} ({description}). Was that money moving between your own accounts rather than being spent?
transfer_why: {candidates} movement(s) of the same amount within a few days on another account you hold.
merchant: What is {example}? You have {count} transaction(s) with it, {money} in total.
merchant_peer_note: (This looks like a payment to a person, so I'll only apply your answer here — not as a rule.)
merchant_why: I have no category for this merchant yet.
nature_single_why: This names how the money moved, not who received it — so I have to ask about each one separately.
nature_group_compound: A payment like that is usually several things at once, and I can't tell the split without the paperwork.
nature_group_why: Because of who they are, not because of anything you told me.
nature_group_why_documents: Your {documents} would let me prove it.
corroboration: You told me about {name} — {money} so far. Do you have the {document}? It would let me prove this, not just record it.
corroboration_why: This account exists because you said so; nothing has attested it.
corroboration_why_unreliable: Its balance also can't be trusted yet, because part of those payments was interest.
free_text_invite: Or tell me in your own words
